models.predictor_source: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index environmental burden raw estimate variables
models.method_note: Used DIABETES_CrudePrev as the dependent variable and used 17 Environmental Justice Index environmental burden raw estimate variables as candidate predictors. Predictors were standardized before LASSO selection. The alpha penalty was selected by scanning a warm-started LASSO path and choosing the model with the lowest BIC. P-values are approximate post-LASSO OLS p-values from refitting ordinary least squares on the selected variables.
